sentences.text: Capsicum chinense , commonly known as the `` bonnet pepper '' is a species of chili pepper native to the Americas .	Capsicum	Capsicum	chili pepper	chili pepper	Americas	Americas
C. chinense varieties are well known for their exceptional heat and unique flavors .	heat	Scoville scale	C. chinense	Capsicum chinense
The hottest peppers in the world are members of this species , with Scoville Heat Unit scores of over 1.5 million .	Scoville Heat Unit	Scoville scale
Some taxonomists consider them to be part of the species C. annuum , and they are a member of the C. annuum complex .	C. annuum	Capsicum annuum

C. annuum and C. chinense pepper plants can generally be identified by the number of flowers or fruit per node , however -- one for C. annuum and two to five for C. chinense , though this method is not always correct .	C. annuum	Capsicum annuum	C. chinense	Capsicum chinense
The two species can also hybridize and generate inter-specific hybrids .
It is believed that C. frutescens is the ancestor to the C. chinense species .	C. frutescens	Capsicum frutescens	C. chinense	Capsicum chinense
